svg.title: Pantry to Plate — Full System Workflow
svg.desc: End-to-end workflow diagram showing user journey, AI pipeline, pantry management, family collaboration, and alert systems for the Pantry to Plate app.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the Pantry to Plate landing page features')
sendPrompt('How does Admin registration work in Pantry to Plate?')
sendPrompt('How does the family member invitation and join flow work?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through the onboarding wizard steps')
g.text: Kitchen setup → invite family → diet prefs → pantry → first AI wow!

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What widgets and features are on the Admin dashboard?')
sendPrompt('What does the Member dashboard show?')
sendPrompt('How does the pantry search and autocomplete work with the master item database?')
sendPrompt('What CRUD operations are available for pantry items?')
sendPrompt('How does inline edit and delete work in the pantry?')
sendPrompt('How does the expiry date tracking and color coding work?')
sendPrompt('How does the content-based filtering meal suggestion algorithm work?')
sendPrompt('How does the Neural Collaborative Filtering preference model work?')
sendPrompt('How does the freshness boost weighting work in the AI suggestion engine?')
sendPrompt('How does dietary constraint filtering work in the AI engine?')
g.text: Dietary constraint filter — veg / jain / upwas / allergy / restricted items

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me how AI meal suggestions are presented to the user')
sendPrompt('How does the 3-course meal planner generate a full menu?')
sendPrompt('How does the AI auto-generate the weekly meal plan?')
sendPrompt('How does the To-Buy list work, including smart suggestions and assignment?')
sendPrompt('How does the recipe library and step-by-step recipe detail page work?')
sendPrompt('How does the real-time family chat work technically with Django Channels?')
sendPrompt('How does the admin broadcast daily meal plans to family members?')
sendPrompt('How do food polls work for family voting on meals?')
sendPrompt('What are the different family member roles and permission levels?')
g.text: Member roles — Admin · Full member · View only

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What diet types does Pantry to Plate support including Jain and Upwas?')
sendPrompt('How does the allergy warning system work when suggesting recipes?')
sendPrompt('How do expiry alerts get triggered and sent to the admin?')
sendPrompt('How does the low stock threshold alert work?')
sendPrompt('How does dairy freshness tracking work separately from expiry dates?')
sendPrompt('How does the AI predict restock needs based on usage patterns?')
sendPrompt('What does the Alert Center dashboard look like and how are alerts prioritised?')
g.text: Critical · Warning · Info — in-app + email + push

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the pantry health score measure and how is it calculated?')
sendPrompt('What does the food waste tracker report show?')
sendPrompt('What does the member activity analytics show the admin?')
sendPrompt('How does the community recipe sharing and rating system work?')
sendPrompt('How do upvotes, saves, and comments work in the community section?')
sendPrompt('How does the community recipe feed get discovered by other families?')
sendPrompt('How is in-app notification delivery implemented via WebSocket?')
sendPrompt('How does email notification delivery work via SendGrid and Celery?')
sendPrompt('How do push notifications work via Firebase for the PWA?')
